result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue with overlapping text in a restaurant card, causing critical content to be unreadable.

issues.description: In the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' restaurant card, the delivery time ('25-35 min') and 'Free delivery' text overlap, making both text elements unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the layout (e.g., use flexbox with proper spacing or a grid) to separate these text elements so they do not overlap and remain legible.
